主要内容: On January 30, 2020, Freshstart Venture Capital Corp., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp, entered into amendments to the Loan Agreement and Note. The amendments extended the maturity date to April 1, 2020. The amendments were entered into while additional amendments to the Loan Agreement and Note were being negotiated and finalized. The description is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Amendments, which are filed as Exhibit 4.1 and Exhibit 10.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.
